text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And, um, I wanna make my moms proud
by
becoming the top Umamusume in all
of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna try my very best from here on
out, so
I'll be counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
